# Support

This repository is public. All issues, pull requests, comments, and attachments may be visible to competitors, researchers, search engines, and the general public. Do not include confidential information, credentials, source code from private repositories, proprietary technical details, customer information, or security-sensitive material.

## Questions

Use the Question issue form for public support questions. If GitHub Discussions are enabled for this repository, use Discussions for broader conversations, ideas, and community help.

## Bugs

Use the Bug Report issue form to report reproducible problems. Provide clear steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, platform details, application version, and sanitized logs or screenshots when helpful.

Security vulnerabilities must not be reported through public issues. Follow the private process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Feature Requests

Use the Feature Request issue form to suggest improvements. Describe the problem, proposed solution, alternatives considered, and any public context that helps explain the request.

## Documentation Feedback

Documentation issues and suggestions are welcome through the Bug Report or Feature Request forms, depending on whether the feedback describes incorrect documentation or a requested improvement.

## Maintainer Prioritization

Maintainers typically prioritize work based on:

- Severity and user impact.
- Reproducibility and clarity of the report.
- Alignment with project scope and roadmap.
- Availability of maintainers and contributors.
- Security, stability, and public documentation needs.

Maintainers should review new submissions for accidental disclosure, redact sensitive information when possible, remove content that should not be publicly disclosed, and redirect security reports to the responsible disclosure process.

All documentation and public interactions should be reviewed through the principle: safe for public disclosure.
